Totems are a type of Minion. They are influenced by Passives and abilities that affect totems.

## Overview[]

Totems are stationary objects that cast various abilities for their duration: some aid their caster with buffs, while others use damaging spells. They expire after a while and cost mana to summon. Only the Primalist and some enemies can summon totems.

Like Minions and Companions, totems have a maximum limit, beyond which the oldest summoned totem will be replaced with a new one at full health on successive casts. This limit is bound to their summoning skill, and it can be extended through certain nodes on their respective trees.
